title: vue-instantsearch: Passing percentage units to the global abs() function is deprecated.
body:
### 🐛 Current behavior

npm run prod generates:
transforming (327) node\_modules\vue-instantsearch\vue3\es\src\components\Menu.vue\_vue\&type=script\&lang.jsDeprecation Warning: Passing percentage units to the global abs() function is deprecated.
In the future, this will emit a CSS abs() function to be resolved by the browser.
To preserve current behavior: math.abs(100%)
To emit a CSS abs() now: abs(#{100%})
More info: https://sass-lang.com/d/abs-percent

### 🔍 Steps to reproduce

npm run prod

### Live reproduction

https://not

### 💭 Expected behavior

No warning

### Package version

vue-instantsearch 4.8.4

### Operating system

*No response*
